title: What a Smart Contract Is
summary: A smart contract is a program stored on a blockchain that runs exactly as written when its conditions are met, without a middleman to execute it.
blocks: A smart contract is a program stored on a blockchain that runs exactly as written when its conditions are met, without a middleman to execute it.
This is what powers most of crypto beyond simple payments — from tokens to lending to exchanges — because the rules live in code that anyone can inspect.
Because they are automatic and hard to change once deployed, bugs or malicious code in a contract can be costly. “Code is law” cuts both ways.
